recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a denim shirt leaning against a sun-drenched, textured plaster wall, featuring a two-tier typographic lockup on the left with heavy weathering and high-contrast textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center to balance left-aligned typography
Warm, yellow-toned lighting contrasting with the cool blue of the denim
Rough wall texture mirrored in the distressed treatment of the lettering
Eye-level gaze creating a direct connection with the viewer
coreInvariants: Denim shirt with visible stitching and pocket details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the denim texture, then across to the bold title text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the upper left to accommodate the primary text elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange (secondary text) and charcoal black (primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value overall with desaturated blues and earthy, warm mid-tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and denim blues

letterConstructionRules: Variable baseline for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the title features a distinctive curved leg and distressed top terminal
Secondary text uses a blocky, industrial sans-serif with rounded corners

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on negative space of wall
aligned with left margin of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, textured display face with a clean, condensed sans-serif.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, stamped aesthetic of the primary title.
Matches the industrial, clean feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium portrait of a man in a light blue denim shirt leaning against a sunlit, cream-colored stucco wall. The lighting should be warm and directional, casting soft shadows. The left side of the frame should be mostly empty wall space. Apply a vintage film grain and warm color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a large, black, heavily distressed woodblock font in the upper left. Below it, add the secondary name in a medium-sized, burnt orange condensed sans-serif font. Ensure the text looks integrated with the wall texture.

verificationChecks: Is the text properly distressed to look like it was stamped on the wall?
Is the color palette dominated by warm creams and denim blues?
Is the subject positioned to the right to balance the text on the left?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the artist name and title
Unique logo marks or branding icons

mustAchieve: Tactile, gritty texture in both image and type
avoid: Perfectly clean vector edges on text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the denim texture is sharp and visible
Check that the orange text is legible against the cream wall
Verify the film grain is consistent across the entire image
Confirm the typography does not overlap the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, sunlit portrait with a left-aligned, two-tier distressed typographic lockup using a warm-toned Americana color palette.
